THE MATCHING RULES

A clear trail for every rupee.

Paymatch matches exact order IDs, adds successful payment amounts, and checks refunds separately. Fees reduce estimated net proceeds, never the gross amount owed.

Import one order per row and one current snapshot per payment ID. Duplicate IDs and invalid amounts are blocked. IDs are case-sensitive; leading zeros are preserved.

INR only · Up to 20,000 rows per file · CSV up to 5 MB
Session data clears when you refresh or close the page.
